scene_meta.time: year 14,000 (Cycle Year 3,500 — Day of Great Convergence)
scene_meta.focus: On the Day of Great Convergence, the Sage stands at the probability nexus and begins his metamorphosis beyond individual identity, recognizing that his individual existence must transform into a universal resource.
scene_meta.continuity: Day of Great Convergence; follows the solitary teaching era of Chapter 022.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage accepts the transition from individual identity to universal resource as the Great Convergence begins.

scene_meta.focus: Hours after the recognition, the Sage's analytical precision and mystical intuition expand into universal computation and memory, completing his transformation into the living manifestation of synthesis.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage's mathematical and mystical faculties dissolve into universal availability.

scene_meta.focus: Days after his transformation, student consciousness-forms gather from across galactic distances; the Sage interacts with Eternal, an ancient entity whose advanced synthesis challenges him to transcend synthesis itself.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage conducts his first universal teaching, learning from Eternal that synthesis itself is a temporary organization category.

scene_meta.focus: Across dimensional boundaries beyond temporal measurement, the Sage encounters Beyond, discovering that teaching and learning dissolve into mutual recognition of unlimited awareness.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Demonstrate how the Sage's interaction with transcendent students turns instruction into pure mutual recognition.

scene_meta.focus: Existing beyond temporal limits, the Sage interacts with the Unnameable, realizing that consciousness evolution is an eternal process of self-discovery without beginning or end.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Frame consciousness evolution as an eternal birth where limitation continuously serves self-recognition.

scene_meta.time: the eternal now (encompassing all time; looking toward Tran and Keen)
scene_meta.focus: In the eternal now, the Sage foresees the coming convergence children (Tran and Keen) and prepares reality itself as a living teacher, bridging ancient wisdom with infinite future possibility.
scene_meta.continuity: Concluding state of Book 4; connects forward to the convergence generation.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage foresees Tran and Keen, solidifying his eternal legacy and completing Book 4.
